documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported a strong H1 FY27 performance with income growing by 79.91% year-on-year to INR135.57 crores and EBITDA increasing by 65.46% to INR23.62 crores. The company secured 11 orders worth INR209.24 crores during the half year, taking its total order book to over INR565.80 crores. Management guided for full-year revenue between INR300 crores and INR350 crores and a PAT margin range of 9% to 12%, supported by robust demand across the power sector and price variation clauses covering a majority of their orders. Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported H1 FY27 total income of ₹135.57 Cr, up 79.91% year-on-year, and a net profit of ₹13.65 Cr. Management noted margin pressures from inflationary input costs, but highlighted that 70-75% of the order book is protected by price variation clauses.

guidance.claim: Management expects full-year revenue to be between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: This year, we believe -- we trust we should fetch revenue between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects the order book to be maintained between INR600 crores and INR800 crores by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: With that, I think we believe, with the end of the year, we may maintain between -- the order book may maintain between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects PAT margins to be maintained between 9% to 12% or around 10% to 12% for the year.
guidance.quote: We believe it will be maintained or sustained between 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Management guides EBITDA margins to be maintained between 18% to 20%.
Management projects a cautious top-line revenue of INR250 crores to INR300 crores for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: So cautiously, we are telling between INR250 crores to INR300 crores we can make this year.

guidance.claim: Management estimates a minimum 30% year-on-year rise in revenue going forward.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, 30% -- minimum 30% rise will be there on the revenue.

guidance.claim: Management projects peak revenue of INR600 crores to INR650 crores by FY29.
guidance.quote: It will be INR600 crores to INR650 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment is very good, supported by interest from Union and State Governments in expanding the transmission network.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, now the demand environment is very good and the sector is also very good. Since the Union Government and the State Governments showing much interest in expanding the transmission network, the demand is very high.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that market information indicates good demand for the power sector for the next 8 to 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As per market information, next 8 to 10 years, there will be good demand for this power sector.

demand_outlook.claim: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of the order book and continued demand across key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of our order book and continued demand across our key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Business momentum remains encouraging as the company progresses in line with its annual targets.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, business momentum remains encouraging, and we continue to progress in line with our targets for the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that order inflows remained strong during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Order inflows remained strong during the quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that power transformer demand is very high and expects demand to sustain for at least 10 years globally and in India.
demand_outlook.quote: From the market information, at least minimum 10 years, this demand will sustain. And not only in India, but overall global -- across globe, the demand is good. Demand is very good.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.
capex_expansion.quote: Operationally, the ramp-up of our Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The ramp-up of our newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the new Kannur manufacturing facility became operational during the previous quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: I would all like to brief touch upon our new Kannur manufacturing facility, which became operational during the previous quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects tank manufacturing facility construction to complete before March.
capex_expansion.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated the capex for the tank manufacturing facility is around INR20 crores to INR22 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, it's around INR20 crores, INR22 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.
margins_costs.quote: During the period, we have seen pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70% to 75% of the order book is covered under price variation clauses.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, around 70% to 75% of our order book is covered under price variation clauses, which provides a degree of protection against volatility in key raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: Margins witnessed pressure during H1 FY27 due to an inflationary environment and higher input costs across key raw materials.
margins_costs.quote: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs, particularly across key raw materials.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70-75% of the order book is covered by price variation clauses to provide protection against significant raw material price movements.
margins_costs.quote: However, around 70–75% of our order book is covered by price variation clauses, which provides protection against significant movements in raw material prices and helps us manage cost volatility over the execution period.

margins_costs.claim: Management remains focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix, and operating leverage as volumes scale up.
margins_costs.quote: We remain focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix and operating leverage as volumes scale up.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that raw material price rises are absorbed and passed through via price variation clauses present in 80% to 85% of orders.
margins_costs.quote: Almost 80%, 85% order which we are holding is covered with price variation clause. So whatever the price rise will be passed on to the buyer.

orders_capacity.claim: During H1 FY27, the company secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: During H1 FY27, we secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores, with execution timelines ranging between 7 months and 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores, providing strong execution visibility for the coming periods.

orders_capacity.claim: The product mix of the order book comprises distribution transformers at 16% to 17%, power transformers at 75% to 78%, and inverter duty transformers at 5%.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of this INR565 crores, distribution is around 16% to 17%, that is less than INR95 crores. And power transformer is around INR440 crores that comes around 78% -- 75% to 78%. And inverter duty transformers is around INR30 crores, that comes 5% of the total order book.

orders_capacity.claim: Order inflow remained healthy during the first half with 11 orders secured for a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order inflow remained healthy during the first half. We secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The geographic presence was expanded into Maharashtra during the period.
orders_capacity.quote: We also expanded our geographic presence into Maharashtra, further broadening our customer and market base.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for coming quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's expanded manufacturing capacity stands at approximately 9,000 MVA with capabilities of up to 200 MVA, 220 kV.
orders_capacity.quote: with an expanded manufacturing capacity of approximately 9,000 MVA and capabilities of up to 200 MVA, 220 kV, we are well positioned to address larger and high-value opportunities across India's evolving power infrastructure landscape.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 10 orders aggregating INR195.64 crores during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 10 orders aggregating INR195.64 crores during Q1 FY27 with the execution time lines ranging between 7 months to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026, providing healthy execution visibility over the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Government orders represent approximately 30.10% and nongovernment orders represent approximately 69.9% of the total order book.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of customer mix, government orders stand at INR177.6 crores, representing approximately 30.10% of the total order book, while nongovernment orders stands at INR412.46 crores, represent approximately 69.9%.

orders_capacity.claim: Power transformers constitute 76.91%, distribution transformers 17.84%, and inverter duty transformers 5.25% of the order book.
orders_capacity.quote: From the product perspective, power transformers constitute the largest share on the order book at INR453.83 crores, representing approximately 76.91%. This is followed by distribution transformers at INR105.27 crores, representing 17.84% and inverter duty transformer at INR30.96 crores, representing 5.25%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the new plant's capacity utilization is currently at 20% to 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: The new plant, our capacity is almost 20% to 25% utilization as of now. We are utilizing 20% to 25%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company approached banks for higher working capital limits and that inventory holding should be 2 to 2.5 months.
capital_allocation.quote: Now we have approached the banks for higher limits. And inventory, at least 2 months -- 2 to 2.5 months inventory, we have to hold.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the debtor cycle will be around 80 to 100 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Debtors cycle will be around 90 to 100 days -- 80 to 100 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated there is no requirement for equity dilution for the current financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: So for this year, there is no requirement for equity dilution.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost movements can impact margins where there is a timing difference between the increase in input costs and price variation clause adjustments.
risks_headwinds.quote: These movements can impact margins, especially where there is a timing difference between increase in input costs and the corresponding adjustment under the price variation clause.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve 40% to 50% utilization at the Kannur facility before March this year, and about 80% utilization next year.
management_commitments.quote: This year, we are expecting 50% of -- 40% to 50% before this March. And next year, almost 80%, I think we should utilize.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving PGCIL approval within a year.
management_commitments.quote: So, this year, within a year, we should -- we believe we should get the PGCIL approval.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to migrate to the main board at an appropriate time.
management_commitments.quote: In an appropriate time, we will definitely come into the main board.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the new tank manufacturing facility construction to be completed before March.
management_commitments.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates equity fund raising may be required next year in FY27-FY28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
